name: watchtower
description: WatchTower — HTTP/API uptime monitoring platform (Express + React). Root-level scripts orchestrate the Backend and Frontend packages.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix Backend install && npm --prefix Frontend install
scripts.build: node scripts/ensure-frontend-deps.mjs && npm --prefix Frontend run build
scripts.lint: npm --prefix Backend run lint && npm --prefix Frontend run lint
scripts.lint:fix: npm --prefix Backend run lint:fix && npm --prefix Frontend run lint:fix
scripts.docker:build: docker build -f Backend/Dockerfile -t watchtower-backend:local . && docker build -f Frontend/Dockerfile -t watchtower-frontend:local ./Frontend
